summary: First end-to-end test pass for Lakshitography. Backend pytest suite (14 cases) covers health, auth, public booking create, admin-protected list/patch/delete, stats, and invalid-status — all PASS (100%). Frontend Playwright validates Home (hero grid 4 tiles + 5 What-I-Do cards + auto-rotation), Services (5 cards + Book→/contact prefill), Gallery (12 items + filter + lightbox open/close), public booking form submission (success view + WhatsApp link), Admin login (admin@lakshitography.com / Lakshita@2025), dashboard load, refresh, status filter, set-status-confirmed, delete (window.confirm accepted), logout redirect, and /admin guard redirecting unauthenticated users to /admin/login.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of the more conventional 201 Created (not breaking, frontend handles 200).

issues: Visual look-and-feel matches the premium dark + gold + warm beige spec; auto-rotation of hero grid confirmed (image src changes after ~6s).

action_items: Note for main agent: the review request referenced testids 'service-card-moments-home' and 'nav-book' / 'wid-card-*' that don't literally exist in code. Actual service slugs are: couple-lifestyle, family-portraits, kids-birthday, anniversary, kitty-gathering. What-I-Do cards use testid 'what-i-do-card-{slug}'. Footer admin link is 'admin-login-link'. Nav book button is 'nav-book' (verified). Consider updating spec/testids to align if expected, otherwise no code change required.
Optional: return 201 on POST /api/bookings for REST correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py JWT_SECRET correctly read from env; bcrypt hashing format $2b$ used.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection and pop('_id', None) — no ObjectId serialization issues.
Admin seeding is idempotent and updates password if changed — matches playbook.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' from env — works since frontend uses Bearer (not cookies); acceptable.

Auth uses Bearer JWT only (no httpOnly cookie). Playbook mentions cookies, but for this app's chosen architecture Bearer is fine and consistent across frontend (lib/api.js attaches Authorization from localStorage 'lkx_token').
No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login — low risk for an admin-only single user but worth noting.
All admin-protected endpoints correctly return 401 when token missing and 403 if role != admin.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created and deleted one TEST_ booking; UI test created one TEST_ui booking via the public form and then confirmed+deleted it via admin dashboard. Database is left clean of TEST_ prefixed records (the public-form one created in UI test still exists if main agent wants to inspect; it was set to confirmed then deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py and can be re-run via: pytest backend/tests/test_api.py -v. Admin token via POST /api/auth/login {email,password}. Service slugs are NOT 'moments-home'; use couple-lifestyle / family-portraits / kids-birthday / anniversary / kitty-gathering. What-I-Do cards: what-i-do-card-{slug}. Gallery filter testids exist as filter-{category}; verify category slugs in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js before asserting count changes.
